Seasonal Pricing
How prices adjust by demand
📊
Current season: Autumn
Prices are at standard rates. Peak season (Spring/Summer) may see 10-15% increases due to higher demand and faster grass growth.
Seasonal Rate Guide
🌸 Spring (Sep-Nov)+10%
☀️ Summer (Dec-Feb)+15%
🍂 Autumn (Mar-May)Standard
❄️ Winter (Jun-Aug)-5%
Seasonal adjustments reflect real demand patterns. Grass grows faster in spring and summer, requiring more frequent service. Winter rates are reduced as maintenance needs decrease. Your area pricing is always shown before you book.

Help & Support
Common Questions
How does the 12-hour guarantee work?
▾
After your job is marked complete, you have 12 hours to raise a dispute. If no dispute is raised, payment automatically transfers to the crew. Your money is always held in escrow until this window closes.
What happens if it rains on my booking day?
▾
If heavy rain is forecast, you and your contractor are both notified and offered the chance to reschedule. Rescheduling due to weather never affects your crew's Retention Score.
How is the Retention Score calculated?
▾
It's the percentage of a contractor's customers who re-book them. A 91% score means 91 out of 100 customers came back. It's harder to fake than star ratings and a better indicator of reliability.
Can I add more than one property?
▾
Yes. Your Crew Pass covers one property. Each additional address is +$5/month. Ideal for investors managing multiple properties all bookings under one account.

Terms & Privacy
Crew Terms of Service
1. The Marketplace
Crew connects homeowners with independent local crews. Crews are not employees of Crew. Each contractor sets their own rates for custom services and is responsible for the quality of their work.
2. Payments & Escrow
All payments are held in escrow by Crew until the 12-hour dispute window closes. Crew charges no commission to crews. A booking fee of $2.99 applies to users without Crew Pass.
3. Disputes
Users may raise a dispute within 12 hours of job completion. Crew admin reviews Before & After photos. The decision of Crew admin is final at the first stage of review.
4. Cancellations
Cancellations more than 24 hours before receive a full refund. 2-24 hours: 50% refund. Less than 2 hours: no refund. Weather-related reschedules are exempt.
5. Governing Law
These terms are governed by the laws of New South Wales, Australia. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of New South Wales courts.

Licenced Trade Services
Verified licence holders only fully covered on Crew
✅
Licenced work is welcome on Crew
All licensed and specialised trade work can be booked and performed through Crew provided the contractor holds a current, verified licence for that trade. Crew verifies every licence before the contractor can accept work in that category.
How licence verification works
1
Contractor submits licence
Photo of licence card + licence number uploaded during onboarding
2
Crew verifies with state authority
Cross-checked against NSW Fair Trading, VIC BSB, QLD QBCC, and equivalent state bodies
3
Verified Pro badge applied
A ✓ Verified Licence badge appears on the contractor's profile and every job they complete
4
Annual renewal check
Crew re-verifies all licences annually. Expired licences are auto-suspended from that trade category
